semiconductor_relevance: High — MiCo Ceramics specializes in ceramic materials and parts for semiconductor equipment, contributing to the domestic semiconductor equipment market.
summary: MiCo Ceramics Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of ceramic materials and components specifically designed for semiconductor equipment. Established in 2020, the company focuses on localizing previously imported materials, enhancing the domestic supply chain for semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Localized ceramic materials for semiconductor applications
Research and development in ceramic technology
